newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's Perm region says plans $50 to $200 mln.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Perm region says plans $50 to $200 mln.

text.p: Russia's Perm region is preparing a Eurobond issue of between $50 and $200 million, the First Deputy Governor of the region said on Tuesday.
Yuri Belousov told Reuters that the regional administration had already had talks with ING-Barings and Russia's Inkombank on organising a credit rating and possibly lead-managing the issue.
He said the region would set up a tender to choose a lead manager next week.

Belousov said the region received nine billion roubles in funding from the federal government this year. According to a draft law on regional Eurobond issues, only regions which do not receive funding from the federal government have the right to issue Eurobonds.
But Belousov said this small amount of federal funding could not prevent Perm from issuing a Eurobond.
"We do not think there will be any special problems with that," he said.
